Re: Jeffery Anderson (DOB 07/10/1957)

September 04, 2025: Mr. Jeffery Anderson was seen today for a follow-up regarding his cataracts. At this visit, his blood pressure was recorded at 145/95 and his weight was 240 pounds. Mr. Anderson has a known history of Prediabetes / impaired fasting glucose, currently controlled, with an A1c level of 5. Additionally, he has Non-obstructive CAD (<50%) / coronary calcium, which is also well-managed, showing a 74% stenosis and a CAC score of 95. His current medications include metformin 500 mg for managing his Prediabetes / impaired fasting glucose.

December 25, 2024: Mr. Anderson visited for his annual physical. His blood pressure was 135/87 and his weight was 234 pounds. Overall, Mr. Anderson is doing well. His A1c level at this visit was 5.1. No significant changes were noted in his health conditions.

April 15, 2024: Mr. Anderson returned for a follow-up regarding his cataracts. His blood pressure was 137/91 and his weight was 237 pounds. The patient continues to do well. His A1c level at this visit was 5.6. His Non-obstructive CAD (<50%) / coronary remains stable with a 74% stenosis and a CAC score of 95.

August 05, 2023: Mr. Anderson was seen for a follow-up concerning his Non-obstructive CAD (<50%) / coronary calcium. His blood pressure was 136/95 and his weight was 230 pounds. Mr. Anderson's Prediabetes / impaired fasting glucose is well-controlled with an A1c of 5.2. His Non-obstructive CAD (<50%) / coronary calcium continues to show 74% stenosis with a CAC score of 95.

A1C trend: The A1c levels have shown the following values past year: September 2025 - 5, December 2024 - 5.1, April 2024 - 5.6, August 2023 - 5.3. This indicates glycemic control.

Social history: Mr. Anderson has a history of tobacco use, having smoked one pack per day since June 2016. quit smoking in May 2021. His alcohol consumption is approximately eight drinks per week. 

Additionally, Mr. Anderson has a family history of significant medical conditions. His mother was diagnosed with breast cancer at age 43 and passed away at age 55. His father had a stroke at age 53 and also passed away. 

Mr. Anderson’s current medications include metformin 500 mg for Prediabetes / impaired fasting glucose and tadalafil 20 mg for erectile dysfunction. Both conditions are currently managed effectively. 

Thank you for your attention to Mr. Anderson's medical history. If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,

Dr. Sean Bowman
Family Medicine
